title: Custom Soccer Ball Net Comforter Set, Machine Washable - A2
description:
Unleash the spirit of the game with the Jeminise Soccer Player Comforter Set, a vibrant addition designed to inspire young soccer enthusiasts. This set is perfect for creating a dynamic soccer-themed bedroom, fueling dreams of the field with personalized touches.

Key Features

  • Soccer Enthusiasm: Designed for young soccer fans, inspiring them with the excitement of their favorite sport.
  • Personalized Design: Features custom options for names and numbers, making it a unique gift for any soccer fan.
  • Easy to Use Bedding: Equipped with a hidden zipper and a smooth metal pull for convenient duvet insertion and removal.
  • Superior Manufacturing Process: Utilizes environmental protection techniques to ensure dye retention and prevent fading, with smooth, fine, and compact stitching.
  • Available Sizes: Offered in US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88").
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water and dries quickly, maintaining its fluffiness over time.
  • Included Components: This set includes a duvet cover and two pillowcases.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Duvet Cover Set
Material Polycotton
Fabric Type Polycotton
Color A4
Style Modern
Pattern Soccer
Selected Design Soccer Player Comforter Set
Included Components Duvet Cover, 2 Pillowcases
Customization Text input (Name & Number)
Available Sizes US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), US King (104" x 88")
Selected Size Full
Pillowcase Length 20 inches
Pillowcase Width 20 inches
Care Instructions Machine Wash
Thread Count 360
